stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS via College Navigator (fall 2024 entering class); no Common Data Set was found on bhsu.edu or by search. College Navigator prints 96% of applicants admitted and 30% of those admitted enrolled, but not the counts, so admits and enrolled are left null rather than computed from rounded percentages. SAT scores were submitted by only 30 enrolled students (6%), ACT by 317 (66%), so the SAT percentiles describe a very small group. GPA, residency and international applicant counts are not published. Undergraduate enrollment (3,301) is the fall 2025 figure from BHSU's Right to Know page; the nonresident-alien share there is a rounded 1.5%, so intl_undergrads is left null. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.
